intro_en: IQTest is MathVista's newly created 228-example visual-logic subset. It sources puzzle-test figures from online learning platforms and tests induction, abstraction, pattern prediction, and calculation. STEM graduate students annotate the items, three reviewers independently verify them, and MathVista extracts, normalizes, and exactly scores model answers.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the IQTest portions of MathVista arXiv:2310.02255 Sections 2.2-2.4, 3.1, Appendix C.4/D.3, and the official lupantech/MathVista data and evaluator. IQTest is one of MathVista's three newly created datasets, not an Intern-S1 text-only benchmark. It contains 228 puzzle-test figure questions sourced from online learning platforms and targets inductive reasoning, abstract thinking, pattern prediction, logical reasoning, and calculations. Graduate students in STEM fields manually annotate questions and answers. Each new dataset is independently checked by three reviewers; across the 736 newly annotated MathVista questions, answer agreement is 99.2%, with only six disagreements, all resolved through full-team discussion. IQTest is standardized as math-targeted figure QA with puzzle-test context, English language, elementary-school grade metadata, and logical/arithmetic skill labels, then included in MathVista's distribution-preserving testmini/test split. Evaluation generates a response from the figure and question, directly extracts already-short choices or integers and otherwise uses the GPT-4 answer extractor validated above 99.5% on 200 examples, normalizes option or numeric format, and reports deterministic exact accuracy.
